Chrome placed the window maximized at (0, 32), 1756 x 956 CSS px on eDP-1 (as Step 0 and SP5c), viewport 1756 x 869 at devicePixelRatio 1.09375; WebGL renderer 'ANGLE (Intel, Mesa Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (ADL GT2), OpenGL 4.6)', the world pages on RegionBatch (canvas data-renderer 'batch', the HUD's 'batch'). Closed with CDP Browser.close (exit code 0), so the profile flushed.

Step 1 (D36): before anything opened it, wi10 held Step 0's record unchanged (schemaVersion 2, generatorVersion 5, genKey 87bc03c64b0ba369, one history step and one diff). Load world listed 'SP5c world · default · seed 4242' with the badge 'older generator' and the line "opens with today's terrain; your blocks stay at their coordinates". Play opened /?world=7010b829-2b39-46e0-9dc1-46313931b7b2 and revealed in 4.0 s with the notice "This world was made with an earlier generator version; it opens with today's terrain and your blocks stay at their coordinates." Reopened with &wiTest=1: blockAt(-1021, 71, -957) = 25 (oak_planks), block history 1 step.

Step 1, the noise caves: in the 41 x 41 columns around the plank (x -1041..-1001, z -977..-937, the plank's column left out), y -64 to 3 above the highest heightAt, 240,240 voxels read with __wiTest.blockAt: 1,936 air voxels at least 5 below their column's heightAt (cave air), from y -64 up to the 64-79 band. The same volume in an unsaved seed-4242 default world of today's build (an ?at= link with the hash {seed:'4242', profile:'default', patch:{}}) hashes the same (FNV-1a c99c2234 in both, cave air 1,936 = 1,936): the migrated world generates exactly today's default terrain, i.e. the SP6a tree with the noise families, not SP5c's tree (which has the carvers only). The X-ray (X) in the SP5c world, looked 50 degrees down from the saved pose, drew the hollows coloured by kind (69.2 % of the canvas' samples coloured): noodles, spaghetti 3D and 2D and cheese (noise families) among the worms, shot 1-sp5c-world-xray.png.

Step 1, after the open: the stored record is today's generator (generatorVersion 7, genKey a793e8164850930b, paramsHash 3d7777aa4d1612ce), its stored params still at schemaVersion 2 (as designed: olderGeneratorRecord rewrites genKey, generatorVersion and paramsHash only; loadParams migrates 2 -> 3 on every read), the edit kept (diffs 1). The Load list's badge is gone after this first open (by design, SP5b D8: the open writes today's genKey), so the badge check could be made once only; it was made before the open.

Step 2 used seed 42's review links (spec §10.10, the Exit evidence's, with &wiTest=1), all unsaved worlds, so no saved world was touched: cheese /?at=97,-52&y=-15.5&yaw=90.0&pitch=0.0&rd=12, interior /?at=174,32&y=-9.5&yaw=0.0&pitch=0.0&rd=12, entrance /?at=38,-16&y=84.5&yaw=315.0&pitch=-60.0&rd=12. Each page waited for the stream to settle at RD 12 (__wiTest.filled() = rd() = 12) before its first shot.

Step 2a, the X-ray in the cheese cavern: X showed the strip 'X-ray · y −64 … 319 · by cave type' (also in the F3 HUD); coloured pixels 0.0 % -> 92.7 % of the canvas' samples, 97.8 % changed. PageDown: 'y −32 … −1' (32 blocks around the eye at y -15.5); PageDown: 'y −40 … −9'; PageUp: 'y −32 … −1'; PageUp: 'y −24 … 7'; Home: 'y −64 … 319'; the first band changed 61.7 % of the picture. X again hid the strip and the terrain came back.

Step 2b, a live cave edit with the map side by side, the X-ray on: M, 'Side by side' (#world-host.split), the Caves tab (every depth, its X-ray box checked), 'Cave parameters' -> Parameters at caves.cheese.offset; 0.5 -> 0.45 typed and committed with Enter (the Apply path of applyControl): the stale count rose to 489, the HUD read 'stale 489 / 489', back to 0 after 6.3 s, the stream settled at RD 12; 39.9 % of the world half's samples changed (the caves moved in place in the X-ray). Ctrl+Z: 'stale 489 / 489', 0 after 6.0 s, the field back to 0.5, the picture back to within 0.04 % of the shot before the edit. Same document throughout (no reload).

Step 2c, the light floor and night vision in the large interior: the eye's voxel and all 405 air voxels in a 9 x 5 x 9 box ahead store light 0 (sky 0, block 0). With night vision off no sampled canvas pixel (399,251 samples, every 2nd device px, the HUD, notices, hotbar and the crosshair's 40 px square left out) is pure black: the darkest reads rgb (2, 2, 3), max-channel p01 4, median 7, mean luminance 6.61. L: 'Night vision on', stored, mean luminance 62.46 (median max-channel 65); L again: 'Night vision off', stored off, mean luminance 6.61 again, pure black 0.

Step 2d, the walk: around the entrance pose, the column whose first floor below the eye lies deepest is (43, -13), floor at y 74, 6.5 blocks away at yaw 122.5. The pointer lock taken by a CDP click, the look turned by CDP mouse moves to yaw 122.5, pitch -35; F -> walk (__wiTest.mode() 'walk'); W held (CDP keyDown, keyUp 4.5 s later): the feet went 84 -> 75 (9 blocks, going down between 0.3 and 2.2 s, then along the floor at 75) and the walk stopped once down at least 6, on the ground and under a roof for 4 samples: at column (50, -7), the first solid block above the head at y 85, the eye's light byte 176 (sky 11, block 0). Shots: start, falling, bottom, and the bottom looking back up at the opening.

Step 3: ?selftest=1 ran in the same kept profile, because it never opens wi10 (src/ui/selftest/selftestPage.ts: the KV contract runs in its own database wi10-selftest, deleted before and after); wi10 read before and after the selftest is identical (counts, the worlds record, history steps, diffs), and wi10-selftest is gone after the run. '✓ all 62 goldens match (11.3 s)' (sp1 27, sp2a 20, sp3a 3, sp3b 2, sp3c 2, sp3e 5, sp6a 3; every key one of test/goldens.json's 62) and 'IndexedDB contract: 10/10 passed'. No separate profile was needed.

The profile's world settings: the kept profile had no 'wi.world.settings' key before the run; the check's side-by-side map and its night-vision toggles wrote one ({mapMode 'split', nightVision false, ...}), which the check removed at the end on the start page, so localStorage's settings are as Step 0 left them (absent).

Rehearsals before the run (runs list): steps 0 and 2 only, three times, in a fresh profile of the check's own (mktemp -d under the agent's scratchpad, removed after), so that the kept profile's one first open of the SP5c world (which removes its 'older generator' badge) was spent only on the recorded run. They settled the X-ray criterion (inside a cavern there is no sky, so the clear-colour share cannot rise: the criterion became the coloured share) and the walk's stop (rehearsal 2 stopped in the open part of the pit; from rehearsal 3 the walk goes on until under a roof). Their figures match the recorded run's (the same strip texts, stale 489 / 489, light-floor and night-vision statistics, the same walk).
observations: With the F3 HUD shown and the X-ray on, the X-ray strip's legend (top centre) is drawn over the right end of the HUD's first two lines at this 1756 CSS px wide window: 'revealed 489 · sections 7145' and the legend's first entries ('Cheese', 'Spaghetti 3D') overlap and are hard to read (shots 1-sp5c-world-xray.png, 2a-cheese-xray-all.png). Cosmetic; F3 hides the HUD (the review shots are taken that way). Not a check failure; for the user's eye.

The first X-ray toggle in the cheese cavern had one frame of 54 ms (one long task of 54 ms) in the 1.2 s after X; frames before it p50 4.16 ms, max 8.34; after it p50 4.17, p95 8.34, p99 12.5. Recorded only (no gate in production; L14's bench covers the X-ray). The live cave edit and its undo had no frame above 20.83 ms and no long task (p50 8.33 ms while 489 columns regenerated).

The light floor's reading: darkest canvas pixel rgb (2, 2, 3), median max-channel 7 at the default brightness 0.3 (the settings' brightness 0.3 in the key the check wrote). Spec §6.1 computes a stone north face at the floor as sRGB 18 at brightness 0.3; this cave at y -10 is darker (darker blocks and texels, distance fog), but nothing reads pure black, which is the check. §6.1 leaves the floor's value to the user's eye.

The stored params of the SP5c world remain at schemaVersion 2 after the open (generatorVersion 7, genKey and paramsHash rewritten): the 2 -> 3 migration runs on every read through loadParams, as §12.4 specifies; it is not written back.
